findings.claim: The README and tests deliberately exclude MsgPack011, MsgPack016, and MsgPack017 for types with SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This is consistent with the recorded product decision: these diagnostics apply only when a formatter is generated, so their omission is not a defect.

receipt_plan.detail: [L11] Generation-only diagnostics (MsgPack011, MsgPack016, MsgPack017) are deliberately not reported for SuppressSourceGeneration = true types; the dynamic resolver handles KeyAttribute-derived keys at run time.
